propositions: Define immutable provider-neutral logical operation and outcome value types with canonical enums: Disposition (applied, already_satisfied, recovered, retryable_deferred, commit_unknown, permanent_failure, exhausted_transient, dependency_deferred, scope_deferred, safety_aborted, skipped), FailureScope (none, ticket, endpoint, tenant, provider, global), ReplaySafety (not_applicable, safe, observe_first, forbidden), DelaySource (none, fallback_jitter, provider, fuse).

Implement single-owner three-invocation, 15-second cumulative fake-clock retry budget in reconciler that permits at most three physical invocations and enforces per-attempt sleep via additive jitter (2^(retry_index+1)+U[0,1) seconds) without adapter-layer retries or sleeps.

Enforce diagnostic entry allowlist (stage, category, status_code, provider_code, retry_after_ms, message) with centralized redaction via rebar.llm.failure.sanitize_diagnostic seam, 512 Unicode code-point truncation per message, and bounded-overflow sentinel (eight entries maximum with ninth-plus encoded as truncated category entry).

Serialize outcomes to byte-identical compact UTF-8 JSON through rebar._store.canonical.canonical_bytes with no inline serializer, ensuring equivalent outcomes produce deterministic canonical representation.

After ambiguous write, observe desired primary-store postcondition before replay; if desired state observed produce recovered outcome, if conclusive old state exists replay only within remaining budget, if observation fails produce non-replaying commit_unknown with ReplaySafety.forbidden.

Retain one canonical logical_id UUID across every physical invocation and observation of a single logical operation, preventing nested cross-layer retry nesting and establishing provable request budget enforcement.
